registryEvidence: The official Municipality of Marília publishes and operates cadastro imobiliário/property services through Portal do Cidadão / Meu Imóvel, including property cadastral certificates and property-data lookup. This establishes a municipal registry/service custodian, not a verified public parcel geometry feed.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal page states property services are being migrated from Meu Imóvel to Portal do Cidadão and lists cadastro imobiliário certificate, property-data proof, property-number lookup, and related services.
Official municipal service information lists Cadastro Imobiliário e Valor Venal, property-data proof, debt services, and property-number lookup; access requires a user account.

Official municipal public application route was reachable. Current Next.js bundle references the municipal API base https://www3.marilia.sp.gov.br/tbservicoswebserver and the Imobiliario/GetImoveisPesquisarImovel and getDadosImovelByIdFisico routes.
Official municipal planning service documents desdobro/unificação de lote procedures and required map/gleba materials; procedural evidence only, not a parcel API.

source: Prefeitura Municipal de Marília cadastro imobiliário / Portal do Cidadão (public service lead; parcel API not verified)

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified request returned the official municipal page. It exposed the property-service descriptions and portal links, but no parcel geometry, source schema, CRS, or public map layer.

TLS-verified request returned HTTP 200 and a Next.js application shell. Current JavaScript/configuration was inspected and identified the official API base and municipal property-search routes; no parcel response was returned by the page shell.
TLS-verified bounded request returned HTTP 400 with a generic CPF/CNPJ-related message. No owner, address, tax, titleholder, or other unsafe fields were pursued; no geometry or schema was returned.
TLS-verified request returned HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed, confirming the inspected route requires POST; no data was returned.

TLS-verified POST with an empty JSON body returned HTTP 400: reCAPTCHA inválido. No CAPTCHA bypass, login, credentials, private token, or unsafe search fields were used; no parcel ID or geometry was returned.
TLS-verified request returned HTTP 404; no public API documentation was exposed at this conventional route.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal property-registry service and public application/API route are evidenced, but no anonymous bounded parcel ID+geometry response, schema, CRS, or citywide coverage was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The official application may expose property records to authenticated or CAPTCHA-validated users, but anonymous parcel geometry, native parcel identity, field schema, CRS, and citywide spatial coverage remain unverified. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
